name: Robin Akiba
source:
Aside from being [url=/c69553]Kira[/url]'s best friend, Robin makes an unbelievable latte. Robin works at the coffee brewery, and visits [url=/c69553]Kira[/url] on a daily basis. Robin is confident and playful but also cares deeply for his friends and family. After becoming friends many years prior, it can be said that [url=/c69553]Kira[/url]'s feelings toward Robin may not be as simple as platonic connection.
